# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 and platforms**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 with expanded .NET, GTK4, Tizen, and Linux support. The release restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies packages, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, and aligns native assets with .NET 11 previews.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the current core fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies packages find system fonts again** — Restores system-font discovery for Linux applications using the NoDependencies package variant. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 applications gain native GPU rendering** — Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with correct pixel scaling for supported GTK4 hosts. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **.NET 11 preview native assets aligned** — Updates WebAssembly native assets and package pins for .NET 11 preview consumers. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Tizen 10 native builds refreshed** — Adds GCC 14.2-based native builds and packaging for the Tizen 10 target. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
